glossary.accecato: Cannot see. Disadvantage on attack rolls, advantage for attackers.
glossary.affascinato: Cannot attack the charm source. Source has advantage on social checks.
glossary.assordato: Cannot hear. Automatically fails checks requiring hearing.
glossary.spaventato: Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is visible.
glossary.afferrato: Speed reduced to 0. Ends if the grappler is incapacitated.
glossary.invisibile: Cannot be seen without magic. Advantage on attack rolls, disadvantage for attackers.
glossary.paralizzato: Incapacitated. Fails STR and DEX saves. Melee hits within 5 ft are critical.
glossary.pietrificato: Turned to stone. Incapacitated, resistance to all damage.
glossary.avvelenato: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
glossary.a terra: Can only crawl. Disadvantage on attack rolls. Melee: advantage, ranged: disadvantage.
glossary.trattenuto: Speed 0. Disadvantage on attack rolls and DEX saves. Attackers have advantage.
glossary.stordito: Incapacitated, cannot move. Fails STR and DEX saves. Attackers have advantage.
glossary.privo di sensi: Incapacitated. Fails STR and DEX saves. Melee hits within 5 ft are critical.
glossary.nascosto: Creatures don't know your location. Attacks against you automatically fail if they can't find you.
glossary.vantaggio: Roll 2d20 and use the highest result.
glossary.svantaggio: Roll 2d20 and use the lowest result.
glossary.concentrazione: When you take damage, succeed on a CON save (DC 10 or half damage). Failing breaks the spell.
glossary.rituale: You can cast this spell as a ritual (+10 minutes, no spell slot required).
glossary.critico: On a natural 20 or critical hit, roll the damage dice twice.
glossary.copertura: Half cover: +2 AC and DEX saves. 3/4 cover: +5 AC and DEX saves. Full cover: cannot be targeted.
glossary.reazione: Special action usable once per round, even outside your turn.
glossary.azione bonus: Additional action granted by class features or specific spells. One per turn.
glossary.finezza: You can use STR or DEX (whichever is higher) for attack and damage.
glossary.leggera: You can use this weapon in two-weapon fighting.
glossary.pesante: Small creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls.
glossary.versatile: You can wield it with two hands to use the damage die in parentheses.
glossary.allungo: Adds 5 ft to your melee reach.
glossary.lancio: You can throw this weapon at range.
glossary.munizioni: Requires ammunition. You recover half your ammunition after combat.
glossary.caricamento: Only one attack per action/bonus action/reaction, regardless of extra attacks.
glossary.attacco di opportunità: Reaction: when a visible creature leaves your reach without Disengaging.
glossary.disimpegno: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks for the rest of the turn.
glossary.scatto: You gain extra movement equal to your speed for the current turn.
glossary.schivata: Until your next turn, attack rolls against you have disadvantage (if you can see the attacker).
